Quota for 2027 Spring semester: 2

But the total quota is two.

We recommend a B2 level according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR) in English or German (depending on whether you apply for an English-taught or a German-taught program at h_da). For more details on the CEFR, see the translation of the CEFR into other languages and the self-evaluation grid available in multiple languages. Here you'll find a rough estimate of the total number of hours typically required to reach the different CEFR levels.

In some cases and for some departments, a B1 level according to the CEFR may be sufficient. Please note, though, that if you have a B1 level, your scores should be closer to a B2 level than to an A2 level.

Many (non-European) language certificates do not categorize your level according to the CEFR. Here's what they correspond to:
CET (China):
CET-6: sufficient
CET-4: may be considered sufficient*
Cambridge Certificate:
160 (Grade C) or higher: sufficient
140-159: may be considered sufficient*
IELTS:
5.5 or higher: sufficient
4.0-5.0;: may be considered sufficient*
TOEFL iBT:
72 or higher: sufficient
43-71: may be considered sufficient*
TOEFL ITP:
543 or higher: sufficient
460-542: may be considered sufficient*
TOEIC Reading and Listening:
785 or higher: sufficient
550-785: may be considered sufficient*
TOEIC Speaking and Writing:
310 or higher: sufficient
240-308: may be considered sufficient*
Duolingo 
Scores of 100-129 are considered a B2 level

*Please note: Your result should be closer to a B2 level than to an A2 level.

What proof of language proficiency is required?
The Common European Framework of Reference for Language (CEFR) is accepted.
International Business (Bachelor's degree): English, C1
TOEFL iBT: minimum 95, IELTS: minimum 7.0, TOEIC: at least 945 points in total (listening: at least 490 points, reading: at least 455 points), Cambridge Certificate: Certificate in Advanced English (CAE)

Other HORIZON programmes (Bachelor's/Master's degree): English, B2
TOEFL iBT: minimum 72, IELTS: minimum 5.0, TOEIC: at least 785 points in total (listening: at least 400 points, reading: at least 385 points), Cambridge Certificate: First Certificate in English (FCE)

Programmes taught in German (Bachelor's/Master's degree): German, B2
TestDaF: minimum TDN3, Goethe Certificate: minimum B2, Certificates of a German Abitur (general university entrance qualification) or a 'Doppel-Abitur' (e.g. German-French Abitur)

Which language proficiency certificates does the HTW Berlin accept?
Please note that the proof of language proficiency must not be older than two years by the time of your application. The same applies to Cambridge Certificates.
English:
TOEFL iBT
IELTS
TOEIC or
Cambridge Certificate

German:
TestDaF
Goethe Certificate
Certificates of a German Abitur/'Doppel-Abitur'

Please note that if your are studying in English or German at your home university, your outgoing coordinator may also confirm your language proficiency. In this case, please contact the international office (or the Language department) at your home university. 【Entry requirements】
To study at Presidency University as an exchange student or study abroad student, you should meet the following criteria:
1. Have successfully completed one year of bachelor’s or one semester of master’s study at a recognized institution.
2. Students must be officially nominated by their home university to participate in the Presidency study abroad/exchange program.
3. Be in good academic standing at your home university.

【English language requirements】
The Presidency University reserves the right to require that any applicant undergo a test of the English language.
Depending on the country of the applicant's home university, additional specifics may be required if they are not already automatically exempt. In such instances, the International Office will evaluate the validity of the waiver request on a case-by-case basis.
IELTS (Academic)
An overall score minimum in IELTS (academic) of 6.0 (with no band score of less than 5.5 - include academic reading, Listening, Speaking and writing modules).
*Note: Results are valid for two years only.
TOEFL iBT
An overall score minimum of 70 with minimum score of: 20 in the writing section; 14 in the reading section; 19 in the speaking section; and 17 in the listening section.
* Note: Results are valid for two years.
